dau.A: Same soft hand-painted storybook style, same round gold-rimmed medallion and same chibi proportions as the reference, but the person is now a young CONSORT (imperial concubine) of the inner palace, a graceful woman about twenty-two with a soft pretty face, black hair in a neat elegant bun with two gold hairpins, a small pearl hair ornament and one small pink flower (no crown, no phoenix), a jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with an ivory (#F1E6D2) collar and light gold embroidery at the shoulders. The medallion disc is now deep blue instead of red. Her face and pose: quiet heartache: brows tilted up in sorrow, eyes lowered and glistening, lips pressed together, mouth closed, exactly ONE single tear on one cheek, holding a small old jade pendant pressed to her chest with both hands. Light posture only: shoulders slightly sunk; no sobbing, no open mouth, no streams of tears, no flying drops, exactly two hands, no big gesture. Both eyes looking together. Everything kept INSIDE the round medallion, the medallion drawn a bit smaller and centred so there is empty space around it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background outside the medallion, nothing else, no text.
dau.B: Same young consort, same soft hand-painted storybook style, same elegant black bun with two gold hairpins, small pearl ornament and small pink flower, same jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with ivory (#F1E6D2) collar, same round gold-rimmed deep blue medallion as the reference. NEW: she is quietly HEARTACHED and leans slightly OUT of the round medallion toward the viewer: her head and shoulders come a little forward over the gold rim, her hands overlap the gold ring; small calm gesture only, no big arms, no waving, no extra hands; both hands pressing a small old jade pendant to her chest just over the gold rim; brows tilted up in sorrow, glistening lowered eyes, lips pressed together, mouth closed, exactly one single tear on one cheek; no sobbing, no streams of tears. Wide jade green sleeves visible. Both eyes looking together. The medallion stays round and centred, a bit smaller, with her popping slightly out of it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background, nothing else, no text.
dau.out: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green the whole time. The young consort with the gold hairpins inside the round gold medallion feels a quiet ache in her heart: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, both hands press a small old jade pendant to her chest, her brows tilt up in sorrow, her eyes glisten and one single tear rolls down; mouth stays closed, no sobbing; she comes out of the round frame only a little toward the viewer. Small calm movements only, exactly two hands, no big arms, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Smooth, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
dau.loop: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green. The young consort with the gold hairpins leaning slightly out of the round gold medallion aches quietly in a slow loop: she holds the jade pendant to her chest, closes her eyes for a moment and breathes in sadly, her lips stay pressed together, the one tear glistens on her cheek; mouth closed, no sobbing, no streams of tears; then she settles back to exactly the starting pose. Small calm movements only, exactly two hands, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Slow enough to read, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
